answer: Farming becomes a trellis bet on surviving 92 epochs of grading, and every bridge settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 92 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 32 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
